description: Use this when the user wants 2-4 power grids side by side, e.g. "PJM,ERCOT" or "ERCOT,AESO,EU_DE_LU": fuel mix, demand, renewable and gas share; queue depth and time to power for the US ISOs.

isos.description: Comma-separated list of 2-4 grids to compare, e.g. "PJM,ERCOT,CAISO" or "ERCOT,AESO,EU_DE_LU": US ISOs (ERCOT, PJM, MISO, CAISO, SPP, NYISO, ISONE), TVA, BPA, utility BAs, or non-US grids (IESO, AESO, HYDROQUEBEC, NGESO, EU_<zone>, TAIPOWER, OCCTO, KEPCO-KR, ONS, AEMO, EMA)

name: compare_isos
title: Compare ISO Regions
